To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we sequenced and analyzed whole genome of an individual of Persian ancestry from Kuwait.
the whole genome sequence of Kuwaiti native from “Persian” subgroup of population is reported.
we have sequenced the whole genome of a Kuwaiti from Persian ancestry at 37X depth, and have identified 3.6 million SNPs, 0.4 million indels and 11,000 structural variations.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the sequencing and analysis of the first whole genome from Kuwait population subgroup of Persian Ancestry, which provides a starting point to understand the genetic diversity of Kuwaiti population and the region.
the genetic variation and diversity in a Kuwaiti native genome of Persian ancestry.
the genetic variation in the Persian population of Kuwait and its implications in disease susceptibility and drug metabolism.

the sequenced genome is an important resource for genetic studies on Persian population, and for the region of Persian ancestry.
the sequenced genome provides a resource for genetic studies in Kuwait and in Persian ancestry populations.
the genome of a Persian individual sequenced in this study is representative of the Persian subgroup of Kuwaiti population.

this is a reference genome for the Persian population subgroup of the Kuwaiti population.
the reported reference genome would be of use to the scientific community for the study of genetic variation in Kuwaiti Persian population and for the study of human genome diversity.
this study is an important step in understanding human genome diversity, especially in the Arabian Peninsula and Persian population.
